subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding dollar-cost averaging as a strategy for investing consistently regardless of market ups and downs
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student simulates investing a fixed amount at regular intervals across a fluctuating price chart and observes the averaged result
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a dollar-cost averaging approach to how it smooths out the effect of market ups and downs
exercise.abstract: Student explains how dollar-cost averaging reduces the risk of investing a large sum at exactly the wrong time

misconception_flags: believes dollar-cost averaging guarantees a profit rather than simply reducing timing risk

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
